notes: «بهذا الإسناد» is written as it stands. The nearest report that writes its chain (prev8, 174) ends at ابن عباس and does not contain the الحسن link this text continues from, so no names are inherited; the earlier reports prev1–prev7 write no chain. The tool holds the reading.
The Imam after «عن» is a narrator. The Persian ya in the text is kept.
